name: entry_point
label: Entry point
description: A file that starts the product: it reads its settings, opens its storage and serves its endpoints. No technical kind of Lathe's fits it.

name: tooling
label: Tooling
description: A config file of the tools the product is checked and tested with, outside the running API, such as the type checker's or the test runner's. No technical kind of Lathe's fits it.
